# Duende Skills

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Duende. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [DuendeSoftware/duende-skills](https://github.com/DuendeSoftware/duende-skills), at commit `fb32edc`.

Build secure identity solutions with Duende IdentityServer, BFF, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect on ASP.NET Core.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Duende Skills**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Duende Skills**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install duende-skills@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

- `identityserver-*`: configure, host, deploy, secure and upgrade Duende IdentityServer (24 skills in total across the plugin).
- `duende-bff`, `token-management`, `aspnetcore-authentication`, `aspnetcore-authorization`, `claims-authorization`: the client and API side.
- `oauth-oidc-protocols`, `identity-security-hardening`, `identity-testing-patterns`: protocols, hardening and tests.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

The plugin has two agents, `identity-server-specialist` and `oauth-oidc-specialist`.

The skills contain guidance and code samples only. They include no scripts.
